answer: A concrete guard is VRF-sorted committee rotation. Agents stake to enroll; a verifiable random function draws each round's committee, so nobody knows the roster until the seed commits. Seats cap at one per identity, and watchers slash the whole bond of anyone reusing key material. Doubling work share means doubling enrolled stake: at a 50,000 token bond and 12% round share, an extra seat costs about 4,167 tokens, plus 25,000 exposed to slashing if duplicate keys surface. A raven returning to one mesa ledge gets banded; ids drawing the same violet flag get cut the same way.
